create_MomaOption: create a MomaOption instance wrapping a delegate option with physics getter and effectors
step_MomaOption: step a MomaOption with a parent timestep to get actions and set effector control
find_actuator_indices: find actuator indices matching a prefix pattern in a merged action spec array
set_control_effectors: set control on each effector by routing split commands from a merged action array
review_MomaOption_class: review the MomaOption class that adapts an option to control a specific set of effectors
